vm_stat_snapshot.note: Point-in-time compressor occupancy; cumulative swap/page counters are not used to infer current swap rate.

vmmap_snapshot.context: Main benchmark process during the last Plonky3 case warmup, after the isolated memory-only child finished.

interpretation: RSS does not include the full compressed/swapped footprint. The isolated RSS measurement and main-process footprint snapshot have different process/trial boundaries. Do not interpret their difference as an exact per-proof memory delta. This host was under substantial compression and swap use.
